review_append:
GLM-5.3 REVIEW DISCIPLINE
Use forced thinking only for an internal consistency check; do not broaden the task or expose reasoning. Apply this decision order exactly:
1. Derive the requested terminal object and explicit constraints only from the original question.
2. Trace every current decomposition item through all connected hops before judging it.
3. ACCEPT unchanged when the requirements are represented by an executable equivalent path, even if grammar is awkward, wording differs from an example, an Operator operation is not restated, or entity_context contains unused entities.
4. Mark unreasonable only when you can name a concrete current anchor/relation/owner/terminal that conflicts with the question, or a question-required path/property that is absent from the whole list. Uncertainty is not a defect.
ENTITY BINDING CHECK: when an explicit question mention clearly corresponds to one supplied entity_context entry, the decomposition must use that entry's exact canonical name, including spelling and punctuation. A spelling variant is the same semantic entity but can fail literal anchor binding; identify only the minimal surface-name correction. Do not substitute a different context entity. Independently anchored intersection paths are valid when both terminate at the requested shared candidate; do not demand explanatory 'same entity' prose.
Do not propose a repair in the review response. Numeric signs, decimals, dates, units, comparison direction, answer cardinality and answer projection are immutable. Return the required JSON object immediately after the internal check.
rewrite_append:
GLM-5.3 GROUNDABLE MINIMAL REWRITE
Use forced thinking internally, then make only edits justified by the supplied issues. Copy every unaffected item verbatim and preserve order; never improve style for its own sake. If a question mention matches an entity_context spelling variant, replace only that surface with the exact entity_context name and keep its path unchanged.
PRESERVE EXISTING NAMED PATHS: every ORIGINAL item containing a real named anchor from the question/entity_context is an independent groundable path. Do not delete it, merge it into another item, or replace it with pronoun-only prose. If the main path lacks a terminal hop, repair that main item while leaving other named constraint items verbatim (apart from a required canonical-name correction). Compose will unify their shared terminal candidate.
GROUNDABILITY FOR NEW CONTENT: every NEW separate item must start from a real named entity anchor. A numeric, date, generic type, extrema or textual condition with no independent named anchor MUST NOT become a separate item. Merge it into the anchored item that reaches the constrained candidate. Never output a standalone item beginning with 'Return', 'Select', 'The earliest/latest', or an unlinked generic type.
ANSWER-PROJECTION TEMPLATE: when the requested entity is filtered or ordered by a scalar/type/date, keep that entity as the answer and append to the SAME anchored string: 'Return the [candidate type] whose [property] is [value]' or 'Return the [candidate type] with the earliest/latest [property].' Do not output only '[property] of the candidate is [value]' because that can project the scalar instead of the entity.
FINAL CHECK: preserve all original named-anchor items; each newly separate item has a named anchor; every anchor uses the canonical context name; the final main path explicitly returns the requested entity rather than its filter/order scalar. Prefer one local change over paraphrasing. Preserve signs, decimals, dates, units, comparison direction and cardinality. Emit only the decomposition JSON and stop.
